svg.title: SenditGo milestones · November 2026 to March 2027
svg.desc: Weekly Gantt in seven lanes. Diamonds mark the five proposed monthly checkpoints. Dashed outlines indicate conditional packages. Each feature links to its scope and ticket details.

g.title: 30 Nov · Planning and prioritisation. Triage AU feedback, confirm feature priorities, reconcile the GA4 backlog and investigate critical App and Web bugs. Lock the executable backlog and dependencies.

18 Dec · UX and requirements. Approve Fleet Web IA and UX, validate core App prototypes with AU operators and agree API contracts and acceptance criteria. Freeze the first release slice before development.

29 Jan · Core development. Deliver Web dispatch and Create Order increments, the App design system, Home, Run Sheet and navigation, and critical GA4 events. Demonstrate usable slices with API readback.
26 Feb · Integration and testing. Integrate scan, POD and offline recovery. Complete and harden Web features, run cross-platform E2E and AU UAT, and update manuals. Verify outcomes on actual builds.
31 Mar · Release readiness. Close severe regressions, validate telemetry and manuals, and run the AU pilot. Decide go or hold for each track and stage approved rollouts.

svg.text: AU feedback intake and weekly triage · 23 Nov – 31 Mar
